variations.explanation: The defender's king has extremely few legal exits; do not confuse an available check with a harmless quiet move. Under this material variant, the Black a7 pawn supplies possible legal moves, so the identical Qf7? is no longer automatically stalemate

variations.label: Candidate and move-order comparison
variations.explanation: Stalemate is a draw regardless of queen material; do not freeze the corner king without checking whether it can move. After g6h5 h8g8 h5g5, the player should recalculate rather than infer a forced win.
